title: New 3BR Home · 30 Min to Nashville · Fast WiFi
description:
Modern 2023 new-build home in Gallatin, TN, just 30 minutes from downtown Nashville. Sleeps 6 in 3 spacious bedrooms (1 king, 2 queens) with 2 full baths. Enjoy vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and a fully equipped kitchen with gas stove. Blazing-fast WiFi and a dedicated workspace make it ideal for remote work. Relax in the private fenced backyard with driveway parking on a quiet residential street. Easy self check-in via smart keypad. Perfect for families, work trips, and Nashville getaways!

The space
This beautifully designed 2023 new-build home features an open-concept living and dining area with vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and designer finishes throughout. The gourmet kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and dishwasher — everything you need to cook and entertain. Three bedrooms (1 king, 2 queens) provide restful retreats with ceiling fans and ample closet space, plus a dedicated workspace for remote work. Two full baths with walk-in showers. Enjoy a fully fenced private backyard and driveway parking.

Guest access
Guests enjoy exclusive access to the entire home — all 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, living room, dining area, fully equipped kitchen, laundry room with washer/dryer, and private fenced backyard. Easy self check-in with a smart keypad. Free driveway parking for up to 2 vehicles. The whole home is yours for your entire stay.

Other things to note
Please note: exterior security cameras are located at the front door and back yard only (no indoor cameras). Trash pickup is on [day] — bins are in the garage. The home is not suitable for pets. This is a smoke-free property — please smoke outside. The garage parking bay is reserved for host use — please use the driveway. The home is in a quiet residential neighborhood, so we appreciate keeping noise levels respectful after 10 PM.
